heading: Impression / Plan
loadError: The impression list could not be loaded. Check the connection and reopen the section.
titleEmpty: The title cannot be empty, so this change is not saved yet.
addedSkipped_one: Added {count} item. Already in the list, not added: {titles}.

newDxHelpIcd10: Tab or "Add to list" creates the entry. First line: the diagnosis, optionally ending with an ICD-10 code. Next lines: the plan.
newDxHelpIcd11: Tab or "Add to list" creates the entry. First line: the diagnosis, optionally ending with an ICD-11 code (e.g. 9C61.0Z&XK9J). Next lines: the plan.
reorderHelp: Reorder with the ↑ ↓ buttons or drag an item by its ⋮⋮ handle. Delete can be undone for a few seconds.
codesHint: Visit codes, modifiers and tests performed are in the Codes section (key 0).
errLocked: This exam is locked, so changes are not saved.
errGone: This visit or item no longer exists. Reload the page.
errServer: Not saved: server error. Try again.
errConnection: Not saved: check the connection and try again.
kindIssueRename: From past history: renaming here changes this visit only; the past-history entry keeps its name.
itemDrag: Drag to reorder item {n}. Use the Move buttons with a keyboard.
itemFindCode: Find a diagnosis code for item {n}
srcFindingsEmpty: No coded findings yet. Findings such as "2+ NS" or "dermatochalasis" appear here as you type them.
srcPohEmpty: No eye problems or eye surgeries in the past history.
srcPmhEmpty: No active general problems in the past history.
builderHelp: Ticked rows are added by "Add selected". A row's Add button (or a double-click) adds just that row. Drag a row onto the list to place it, or onto the New Dx box to edit it first.
ordersHelp: Ticked orders show at the next visit. Orders with a CPT code show as tests in the Codes section.
ordersNotOwner: This is {owner}'s orders list; only they can change it.
ordersEditorHelp: Changes apply to future visits; visits already saved keep their orders.
orderNewPlaceholder: New order, e.g. Return in 2 weeks
ordersEmptyCanEdit: The orders list is empty. Use Edit list to add orders.
ordersPlanPlaceholder: e.g. RTC 6 months for dilated exam
